// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  // Pre-stage all A and B scale buffers ONCE before the tiled loop.
  // Cost: O(BLOCKS_M + BLOCKS_N) memcpy, vs O(BLOCKS_M * BLOCKS_N) in original.
  // A_scales_blk[i0][g][col] = A_scales_row[g][i0*BLK + col]
  static uint8_t A_scales_blk[BLOCKS_M][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];
  static uint8_t B_scales_blk[BLOCKS_N][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
    if (mrows <= 0) continue;
    if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
      memcpy(&A_scales_blk[i0][g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
  }

  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
    if (ncols <= 0) continue;
    if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
      memcpy(&B_scales_blk[j0][g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
  }

  int tiles    = BLK / DIM;
  int tiles_K  = MATMUL_K / DIM;
  uint32_t a_base   = 0;
  uint32_t b_base   = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
  int      SPAD_DEST = 128;

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
    if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
    if (mrows <= 0) continue;

    // Configure execution once per i0 row-block.
    // Config fields (format, dataflow) are unchanged across j0 iterations;
    // re-issue only at i0 boundary to satisfy programming model sequence.
    gemmini_flush(0);
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                1, 1, 0, 0, false,
                                /*act_mx_fmt*/0, /*wgt_mx_fmt*/0,
                                /*out_mx_fmt*/3, /*uselut*/0);

    // Load A scales ONCE per i0 — identical across all j0 for this row-block.
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_scales_blk[i0], A_S_BYTES, 0);

    // Mvin A tiles for this i0 block ONCE — same A tiles used for every j0.
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));  // A row stride = K bytes
    for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
        gemmini_extended_mvin(
          (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
          a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM,
          DIM, DIM);

    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;

      int pad_i = BLK - mrows;
      int pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // Load B scales ONCE per j0 — identical across all i0 for this col-block.
      // A scales were loaded above at i0 granularity; re-load A scales here
      // only when we re-enter j0 loop (A scale already in hw from i0 hoist,
      // but programming model requires both A and B scales to be loaded before
      // each compute invocation per the sequence rule).
      // To satisfy the mandatory ordering (config_ex -> load_scales A -> load_scales B
      // -> mvin -> mxquant_config_mvout -> loop_ws_spad -> read_smem -> fence),
      // we re-issue config_ex + A scale load + A mvin once per (i0, j0) only
      // for the A-scale/config state, but hoist the A memcpy cost out of j0.
      // Since A scales persist in hardware until overwritten, and we only
      // overwrite them here with the same data, a single load per i0 suffices
      // for hardware correctness. However the programming model sequence
      // requires: for each compute call, the preceding scale loads must have
      // been issued. The A scale load at the top of i0 satisfies this for
      // the first j0; for subsequent j0 we must re-issue per the spec.
      // Re-issue A scale load (no memcpy cost — buffer already prepared):
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_scales_blk[i0], A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_scales_blk[j0], B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // Mvin B tiles for this j0 block.
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));  // B row stride = N bytes
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
            (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
            b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM,
            DIM, DIM);

      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                   tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                                   0, 0, 1);

      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                           pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                           a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS,
                           0, SPAD_DEST,
                           false, false,
                           false, false, false,
                           NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++)
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(
          &C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
          SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK,
          ncols);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
